answer: One chip, one identity: a fresh attestation quote is required every 16 epochs and a chip caught signing for two keys burns both seats. Building 295 fake identities means buying 295 chips, each worth more than the epoch payout, while an honest agent uses the device it already has. The meadow of the design is public, the gale of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the dune of honest work is what finally pays.
